name: Ramey (2016) Handbook of Macroeconomics data
used_in: Ramey (2016); Romer and Romer (2004); Christiano, Eichenbaum and Evans (1999); Coibion (2012); Ramey (2011)
notes: Single zip with monetary, fiscal, technology and uncertainty shock series plus the Stata/Matlab code used in the Handbook chapter. Also hosts Ramey-Zubairy (2018) military news shocks.

name: Romer and Romer (2004) monetary policy shocks
used_in: Romer and Romer (2004); Coibion (2012); Ramey (2016)
notes: Narrative shocks from Greenbook forecasts. Updated series to 2007 (Coibion et al. 2017) and 2019 (Wieland and Yang) circulate; the Ramey zip bundles one.

name: Kilian (2009) oil market VAR data
used_in: Kilian (2009); Kilian and Murphy (2014); Baumeister and Hamilton (2019)
notes: World oil production, global real activity index, real oil price. The activity index is maintained by the Dallas Fed (IGREA).

name: Kilian global real economic activity index
used_in: Kilian (2009); Kilian and Zhou (2018)
notes: Corrected and updated by the Dallas Fed; download as xlsx.

name: FRED-MD / FRED-QD
used_in: McCracken and Ng (2016); Stock and Watson (2016); Bernanke, Boivin and Eliasz (2005) updates
notes: Drop-in replacement for the Stock-Watson large panels (e.g. the 120 series in bbe2005). Monthly vintages are archived so results can be pinned to a date.

name: Gilchrist and Zakrajsek (2012) excess bond premium
used_in: Gilchrist and Zakrajsek (2012); Gertler and Karadi (2015)
notes: Updated monthly by the Fed Board (ebp_csv.csv). This is the `ebp` column in gk2015.

name: Gertler and Karadi (2015) high-frequency surprises
used_in: Gertler and Karadi (2015); Ramey (2016); Jarocinski and Karadi (2020)
notes: Replication package on the AEA site. Extended surprise series are maintained by Jarocinski and Karadi (2020) and by Bauer and Swanson (2023).

name: Jarocinski and Karadi (2020) monetary and information shocks
used_in: Jarocinski and Karadi (2020)
notes: Poor man's sign restrictions split of high-frequency surprises. AEA replication package.

name: Bauer and Swanson (2023) monetary policy surprises
used_in: Bauer and Swanson (2023)
notes: Orthogonalised FOMC announcement surprises; updated on the author's site.

name: Miranda-Agrippino and Ricco (2021) informationally-robust shocks
used_in: Miranda-Agrippino and Ricco (2021)
notes: Monetary policy shock series purged of central bank information effects.

name: Mertens and Ravn (2013) narrative tax shocks
used_in: Mertens and Ravn (2013); Mertens and Ravn (2014)
notes: Personal and corporate income tax narrative measures used as external instruments.

name: Auerbach and Gorodnichenko (2012) fiscal multipliers
used_in: Auerbach and Gorodnichenko (2012)
notes: AEA replication package with forecasts from SPF and Greenbook.

name: Fernald utilization-adjusted TFP
used_in: Fernald (2014); Basu, Fernald and Kimball (2006); Gali (1999) updates
notes: Updated quarterly by the San Francisco Fed.

name: Jurado, Ludvigson and Ng (2015) uncertainty indexes
used_in: Jurado, Ludvigson and Ng (2015); Ludvigson, Ma and Ng (2021)
notes: Macro, real and financial uncertainty at 1, 3 and 12 month horizons; updated regularly.

name: Economic Policy Uncertainty index
used_in: Baker, Bloom and Davis (2016)
notes: US and country-level indexes plus categorical sub-indexes.

name: Wu and Xia (2016) shadow federal funds rate
used_in: Wu and Xia (2016)
notes: Drop-in policy rate for VARs spanning the zero lower bound.

name: Shiller online data (S&P, CAPE, house prices)
used_in: Shiller (1981); Campbell and Shiller (1988); Phillips, Shi and Yu (2015); Case and Shiller (2003)
notes: The long S&P price/dividend/earnings series behind psy2015 and most bubble tests.

name: Jorda-Schularick-Taylor Macrohistory Database
used_in: Schularick and Taylor (2012); Jorda, Schularick and Taylor (2017); Jorda et al. (2019)
notes: 18 advanced economies, 1870 onwards. CC BY-NC-SA licence; download as xlsx or dta.

name: Reinhart and Rogoff crisis chronologies
used_in: Reinhart and Rogoff (2009); Reinhart and Rogoff (2011)
notes: Country-level crisis dates and debt series.

name: Laeven and Valencia systemic banking crises database
used_in: Laeven and Valencia (2013); Laeven and Valencia (2020)
notes: IMF WP 18/206 with the database as an appendix xlsx.

name: Penn World Table
used_in: Mankiw, Romer and Weil (1992); Hall and Jones (1999); Feenstra, Inklaar and Timmer (2015)
notes: Also on CRAN as the `pwt10` package.

name: Maddison Project Database
used_in: Bolt and van Zanden (2020)
notes: Long-run GDP per capita. CRAN: `maddison` package.

name: Barro-Lee educational attainment
used_in: Barro and Lee (2013)
notes: Download as csv or dta from the project site.

name: Acemoglu, Johnson and Robinson (2001) settler mortality
used_in: Acemoglu, Johnson and Robinson (2001); Albouy (2012)
notes: Data archive on Acemoglu's MIT page covers most of his published papers.

name: Nelson and Plosser (1982) US macro series
used_in: Nelson and Plosser (1982); Perron (1989); Zivot and Andrews (1992)
notes: Bundled in R: `tseries::NelPlo`. Extended to 1988 by Schotman and van Dijk (1991).

name: Lutkepohl (2005) and JMulTi textbook datasets
used_in: Lutkepohl (2005); Pfaff (2008)
notes: Bundled in R: `vars::Canada`; e1-e6 datasets ship with JMulTi and `urca`.

name: Kilian and Lutkepohl (2017) textbook datasets
used_in: Kilian and Lutkepohl (2017)
notes: The `kl2017` and `oil` datasets in this package come from here; the site has the full chapter-by-chapter data and Matlab code.

name: AEA Data and Code Repository (openICPSR)
used_in: Any AER, AEJ, JEP or JEL paper since 2019
notes: Mandatory replication packages for all AEA journals. Search by DOI.

name: Journal of Applied Econometrics Data Archive
used_in: Any JAE paper since 1988
notes: Long-running archive; most classic applied time-series papers (Hamilton, Perron, Pesaran...) have entries.

name: Harvard Dataverse
used_in: QJE, ReStud, JPE, Econometrica replication packages
notes: Many top-5 journals deposit replication packages here; search by paper title.

name: Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED)
used_in: Nearly every US macro paper
notes: R access via `fredr` or `quantmod::getSymbols(src = 'FRED')`. ALFRED holds real-time vintages.
